title: asplenium seelosii subsp. celtibericum
intro: Asplenium seelosii subsp. celtibericum, commonly known as the Spanish maidenhair spleenwort, is a rare species of fern that belongs to the Asplenium genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium seelosii subsp. celtibericum are attributed to its ability to relax bronchial muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
